page_title: CMSV7--Parameters are sent to register a private platform
page_content:
[TOC]

### Prerequisites:
- The device network can access the Internet normally, for example: 4G dial-up is successful or wired network routing is successful or WiFi connection is successful, refer to "Function Usage" >>> "Network Function" article introduction!

### Operation steps:

1. The device is issued through local tools, remote plug-ins, etc. For specific methods, refer to the "Function Use" >>> "Configuration Tool" article introduction
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=497cf0d5bc5aa0317b8e63b5e62bd75b)

2. Copy the parameter instructions of the registration platform and issue them. For specific instructions, refer to the [Common Configuration Parameter Instructions](http://pug2.4000329988.com/web/#/13/83 "Common Configuration Parameter Instructions") article introduction
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_SET"><stBaseInfo strFD_DeviceNo="111111"/> <stCMS ucFD_AddressType="0" uiFD_IP="" strFD_Domain="" usFD_Port="6608" /></VariCfgSec>
```
> Parameter Notes:
strFD_DeviceNo="111111":Device number;
ucFD_AddressType="0":Connection type IP registration;"1"Domain registration;
uiFD_IP="":Registered IP address;
strFD_Domain="hy.ent.cn":Registered domain name address;
usFD_Port="6608":Registered port

3. It takes effect immediately after being successfully issued, and no restart is required

4. Check whether the registration is successful locally or check whether the platform is online
